content: हस्तिन् {%a.%} (-नी|{%f.%}) [हस्तः शुण्डादण्डोऽस्त्यस्य इनि] .²1 Having hands. .²2 Having a trunk. --{%m.%} An elephant; <ls>Ms. 7. 96</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">12. 43</ls>; (elephants are said to be of four kinds; भद्र, मन्द्र, मृग, and मिश्र).

हस्तिनी .²1 A female elephant. .²2 A kind of drug and perfume. .²3 A woman of a particular class, one of the four classes into which writers on erotical science divide women (described as having thick lips, thick hips, thick fingers, large breasts, dark complexion, and libidinous appetite); the Ratimañjarī thus describes her:-- स्थूलाधरा स्थूलनितम्बबिम्बा स्थूलाङ्गुलिः स्थूलकुचा सुशीला . कामोत्सुका गाढरतिप्रिया च नितान्तभोक्त्री (नितम्बखर्वा) खलु हस्तिनी स्यात् (करिणी मता सा) <ls n="Ratimañjarī">8</ls>.
